sample_unit: patients surveyed (plus 9 standardized oral leukoplakia questions rated by 10 specialists)
models_evaluated: six mainstream Chinese LLMs in total

links.outcome: Readability of LLM responses to oral leukoplakia questions, measured with the ARC tool
links.effect: Doubao had the best readability (weighted total 0.511); DeepSeek (0.358) and Tencent Hunyuan (0.369) had relatively poor readability, and these two also had the highest QAMAI quality scores.
links.quote: ARC readability analysis indicated that ByteDance Doubao had the best readability (weighted total score 0.511), while DeepSeek and Tencent Hunyuan had relatively poor readability (0.358 and 0.369, respectively).

links.outcome: Quality of sources and references in LLM answers to oral leukoplakia questions (QAMAI dimension)
links.effect: All six models scored relatively low on the sources and references dimension, so answers were not traceable to reliable evidence.
links.quote: All models scored relatively low on the "sources and references" dimension.

screen.reason: The study surveyed actual patients regarding their use of AI for oral mucosal disease consultation and evaluated several Chinese LLMs using expert clinician ratings on standardized questions.
